use_cases.UC1: Initial Page State — page loads with empty file input, heading, and no upload confirmation
use_cases.UC2: Single File Upload Happy Path — select a .txt file, submit, and verify confirmation view
use_cases.UC3: File Extension Variants — upload .png/.json/.pdf files and verify filename displayed correctly
use_cases.UC4: Special Characters in Filename — upload files with spaces, parentheses, hyphens, underscores, and mixed special characters
use_cases.UC5: Negative and Edge Cases — no file selected, cleared selection, very long filename, duplicate uploads
use_cases.UC6: State Reset After Upload — navigating back or reloading returns to initial empty state

tests.title: Verify page load shows empty file input and no upload confirmation
Verify instructional text and page structural elements
Upload a single .txt file and verify confirmation view
Upload a .png file and verify filename displayed correctly
Upload a .json file and verify filename displayed correctly
Upload a .pdf file and verify filename displayed correctly
Upload file with spaces in name and verify exact filename displayed
Upload file with spaces and parentheses and verify exact filename displayed
Upload file with hyphens and underscores in name
Upload file with mixed special characters
Click Upload with no file selected and verify behavior
Select file, clear selection, then click Upload
Upload file with very long filename
Upload same file twice in succession
Navigate back to upload page after successful upload resets state
Reload confirmation page returns to initial upload state

defects.title: Instructional text 'Choose a file on your computer' not found on upload page
steps: Inspect the page for instructional content.
defects.expected: Instructional text about choosing a file and uploading is visible on the page.
defects.actual: getByText('Choose a file on your computer') times out after 10 seconds — the expected instructional text is not present in the DOM.

defects.title: Reloading confirmation page does not return to initial upload state
steps: Select and upload a test file.
defects.expected: Page returns to the initial upload state with 'File Uploader' heading visible and empty file input.
defects.actual: After page reload, getByRole('heading', { name: 'File Uploader' }) is not found — the page does not reset to the initial upload form state.
